injury_predictions.name: Josh Jacobs
injury_predictions.note: Pleaded no contest Sept 10 (criminal case resolved). Remains on Commissioner's Exempt List (paid, can't play/practice); NFL confirms no timetable for discipline. Standard domestic-violence-case suspension is 6 games, could be shorter or longer.

injury_predictions.name: Travis Etienne
injury_predictions.note: Placed on IR with the Week 3 hamstring injury; must miss at least four games. Earliest return is Week 9 vs CLE (Nov 8) - Saints bye is Week 8.
injury_predictions.source: RotoBaller, NBC Sports (PFT), Saints injury report

injury_predictions.name: Deebo Samuel
injury_predictions.note: Right hamstring strain, hurt Week 5 vs SEA. Shanahan: strained it 'pretty good', will miss 'at least a couple weeks'; MRI confirmed a multi-week absence. Out Week 6 vs WAS and Week 7 at ATL; 49ers bye is Week 8, so Week 9 is the earliest realistic return.

injury_predictions.name: TreVeyon Henderson
injury_predictions.note: Right high-ankle sprain, hurt Week 5 vs LV; MRI Monday 10/12. Schefter: expected to miss multiple weeks, no surgery, not reported on IR. No firm timeline - Week 9 (three missed games) is a midpoint estimate, unconfirmed. Rhamondre Stevenson leads the backfield meanwhile.
injury_predictions.source: Adam Schefter (ESPN) via RotoWire, Pats Pulpit

injury_predictions.name: Jordyn Tyson
injury_predictions.note: IR (designated to return), right hamstring strain. Schefter (10/5): making progress but won't be activated before Week 7 at the soonest; Saints bye is Week 8, so Week 9 vs CLE is the more likely debut. Moore said he would not practice this week. Week 7 remains possible.
injury_predictions.source: Adam Schefter (ESPN) via The Fantasy Footballers, Kellen Moore via NBC Sports

injury_predictions.name: Zach Charbonnet
injury_predictions.note: Reserve/PUP (ACL, Jan 17). Practice window opened 10/1. Mike Macdonald said 10/5 he won't be activated for Week 5 vs SF; Week 6 is the earliest game.
injury_predictions.source: Gregg Bell (Tacoma News Tribune) via ESPN/RotoWire

injury_predictions.name: Jadarian Price
injury_predictions.note: Placed on IR 10/3 after aggravating a chest injury (first hurt Week 2) in practice. Must miss at least 4 games (Weeks 4-7); Week 8 is the earliest.
injury_predictions.source: Seahawks via NBC Sports (PFT), FOX 13 Seattle, TSN

injury_predictions.name: A.J. Brown
injury_predictions.note: On IR, high-ankle sprain. Week 6 (vs NYJ) was the earliest eligible date, but Rapoport (9/22): 'the expectation is he misses six weeks' - Patriots determined the injury is more serious than the initial 4-6 wk range suggested. Realistic return is Week 8 vs MIA.

injury_predictions.name: Jordan Mason
injury_predictions.note: IR (fractured thumb, surgery), placed 9/16 so must miss Weeks 2-5; Vikings are on bye Week 6, so Week 7 is the earliest game. O'Connell expects him back at the short-term IR minimum. Aaron Jones is Minnesota's lead back - Mason projects as backup/change-of-pace once healthy.
injury_predictions.source: NBC Sports, NFL.com, Kevin O'Connell, Ian Rapoport

injury_predictions.name: Kyle Monangai
injury_predictions.note: Out Week 5 at GB (thumb/toe). Jeremy Fowler: dealing with turf toe and could miss another week or two. Week 7 is a midpoint estimate, unconfirmed. D'Andre Swift keeps the lead role.
injury_predictions.source: Jeremy Fowler (ESPN) via ESPN Fantasy inactives column, Sleeper status

injury_predictions.name: Jonah Coleman
injury_predictions.note: IR 9/26 with a high-ankle sprain suffered Week 2. Must miss at least 4 games; Week 7 vs ARI is the earliest return.
